laterCallerAliasCounterexample.meaning: An exit projection does not authorize generic call replacement.

harnessRepairs: First uncommitted build needed a locally narrowed Clang path in the native test closure.
First test harness used pre-order rather than required callee-first module ordering.
Second native harness omitted required host IO macros for its no-effect mixed module. Corrected before the passing78-test run.

limits: Every original public function, parameter ABI, interpreter operation graph, diagnostic frame and default route is retained.
Detached helper fuel and resource frame names differ; strict functions refuse.
Emission is optimize:false without trap instrumentation; no source-call or caller-consumer rewrite occurs.
Opaque retention grants no private ownership or permission to hoist/delay captures across callbacks.
The real ap_read guarded three-field state still refuses the old owned-fold proof. Formal parameter/effect demand and guarded0-or-1 closure remain absent.
No formal cohort, timing, RSS, physical copy, LLVM instruction, all-target/full gate, performance or whole-bootstrap2MiB-floor claim.
decision: Freeze the selected-subtree law and retained counterexample. Do not adopt; prove lawful capture-point-aware known-call/effect and guarded0-or-1 fold closure before considering actual ap_read specialization.
